# Beyond Spacetime digital science museum

> Original educational companion to ArcSecs. Premises, conditional mathematics, computational verification and empirical evidence are distinct. No claim of model-training inclusion or observational validation.

## Unified discovery
- [Museum](https://beyondspacetime.org/museum/)
- [Search](https://beyondspacetime.org/museum/search/)
- [Structured index](https://beyondspacetime.org/museum/catalog.json)
- [Search API and guide](https://beyondspacetime.org/museum/guide/)
- [Sitemap index](https://beyondspacetime.org/museum/sitemap-index.xml)
